# uxp-lint/no-unsupported-web-api

Disallow browser APIs that UXP does not provide or documents as unreliable.

**Type:** problem · **Recommended:** warn · **Strict:** error

## What it checks

Reports `MutationObserver`, `matchMedia`, `performance.measure` (community-reported as unavailable; turn off with `community: false`), `keypress` listeners and handlers (docs), scripts or inline handlers in `innerHTML` strings (docs), and `localStorage`/`sessionStorage` in `.psjs`/`.idjs` scripts (docs: scripts have no persistent storage). Feature-detected uses (`typeof X`, `if (window.X)`, `window.X?.()`, `try`) are allowed.

## Examples

### Incorrect

```js
const mq = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)");
```

### Correct

```js
const mq = window.matchMedia?.("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)");
```

## Options

| Option | Type |
|---|---|
| `community` | boolean |
| `scriptFilePattern` | string |

## Messages

- `unavailable`: {{message}} ({{confidence}} source: {{source}})
- `event`: {{message}}
- `innerHtmlScript`: Do not rely on scripts or inline event handlers inside `innerHTML` in UXP; Adobe says this behaviour "will likely go away". Use addEventListener.
- `storageInScript`: UXP scripts (.psjs) have no persistent storage; `{{name}}` is unavailable there.

## When not to use it

If you ship a polyfill for the reported API.
